_comment: Claw Proxy configuration. Copy to keys.json and replace placeholders with real upstream keys. AI-facing fields (description/quota/note) should be English; keep Chinese notes in *_cn fields which /models never emits. Optional fields may be omitted entirely - /models only emits fields that are present.

models.description: Short English capability note returned to orchestrators by /models (helps the agent pick the right tier).

quota.note: Optional. Set query_url only if the provider exposes a quota-query API; otherwise leave null. Actual consumption through this proxy: GET /api/status -> model_usage.
